name: GitHub Tasks
description: Browse GitHub tasks, discuss issues and work with Projects v2.

method.description: Read daemon-owned Tasks navigation, preferences, session draft and workspace links.

repoIds.description: Repository IDs, or null for sticky all.

detail.description: Nullable item target: worktree, kind, number, optional url, projectId, itemId, host, owner and repo.

project.description: Nullable Project target: id, owner, ownerType, number, url and optional host/title/viewId/viewNumber.

defaultRepoSelection.description: Repository IDs, or null for sticky all.

links.description: Canonical work-item identity to workspace link: worktree, name, url and repoId.

method.description: List registered Git repositories and their primary workspace contexts.
Open Tasks, optionally deep-linked to a mode, repository selection or item.

repoIds.description: Repository IDs, or null for sticky all.

result.description: The updated state projection; see the state method's result schema.

result.description: The updated state projection; see the state method's result schema.

method.description: List bounded, per-repository GitHub issues or pull requests with source availability, provenance, pagination and partial failures.

worktree.description: Optional existing worktree context used by the API caller.

repoIds.description: Repository IDs to include, or null for sticky all. Omit to use current Tasks navigation.

query.description: GitHub search query, limited to 8192 UTF-8 bytes.

items.description: Bounded list-row item; body text is omitted. Workspace context is attached when linked.

failures.description: Source, list or count failures; successful repository rows remain available.

sources.description: Per-repository availability, authenticated host, origin, issue source and fallback provenance.

method.description: Apply a validated issue or pull-request row mutation through the public GitHub hosting API.
method.confirm: Apply the requested GitHub Tasks row mutation?

duplicateOf.description: A positive, different issue number in the same repository.

assignees.description: Replace the issue assignee set; at most 100 values.

reviewerText.description: Comma/space separated reviewer logins, at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes and 15 reviewers.

expectedHead.description: The confirmed current PR head SHA; the hosting API rechecks it before merge.

result.description: Explicit provider mutation outcome; queued/pending is never reported as merged.

method.description: Read bounded check status for a pull request row.

result.description: Hosting check rollup, bounded check rows, and partial failure metadata.

method.description: List bounded repository labels or assignable users, and recent pull-request participants, for Tasks pickers.

result.description: Hosting label/assignee results, or reviewer participant and suggestion lists.

method.description: Load current pull-request merge metadata before showing merge actions; absent safety metadata never enables merge.

mergeQueueRequired.description: True, false, or null when the public provider could not confirm queue policy.

autoMergeAllowed.description: True, false, or null when repository auto-merge capability is unknown.

method.description: Resume, link, unlink, or start a real workspace for a GitHub task. Start returns a visible prefilled composer unless an explicit Project direct-start agent path is available.

trustSetup.description: Only accepted after an explicit composer approval to run this untrusted setup once.

trustSetupHash.description: Creator-issued hash of the displayed shared setup; required with composer one-time setup approval.

issueCommand.description: Issue command choice independent of repository setup.

trustIssueCommand.description: One-time approval of the displayed shared issue command in the active composer.

trustIssueCommandHash.description: Creator-issued hash pinning one-time issue-command approval.

composerRequestId.description: Active daemon-held composer request required when submitting the visible form.

worktree.description: Workspace ID for linked/resumed results; the public workspace record for a created result.

setup.description: Setup policy for a composer result; the public setup outcome for a created result.

setupDecisionRequired.description: The visible composer must collect an explicit setup run-or-skip choice.

blocked.description: Creation is waiting for a setup or hook-trust decision.

agentPending.description: Agent launch is waiting for repository setup, not confirmed delivery.

promptDelivery.description: Observed public session promptDelivery; pending, unconfirmed and not-delivered are not delivered.

issueCommand.description: Independent issue-command choice in a composer or canonical execution outcome after creation.

trustScript.description: The exact untrusted shared hook content requiring a decision.

trustHash.description: Creator-issued SHA-256 of the displayed hook content.

trustChanged.description: The displayed script differs from a previously trusted or displayed version.

trustSetupHash.description: Retained setup approval pinned to its displayed hash.

trustIssueCommandHash.description: Retained issue-command approval pinned to its displayed hash.

method.description: Read the current daemon-owned visible workspace composer request, or null.

result.description: The pending composer request, or null when no request is open.

method.description: Cancel the matching daemon-held workspace composer request without changing any workspace.

result.description: The remaining composer request, or null.

method.description: Read the selected GitHub issue, bounded comments, participants, and timeline through the public hosting API.

worktree.description: Registered local Git worktree; omitted uses the open issue or caller context.

number.description: Issue number; omitted uses the open issue detail.

url.description: Credential-free HTTPS GitHub issue URL, used to preserve repository identity.

refresh.description: Bypass the local issue-detail cache for an explicit re-read.

result.description: Normalized issue detail. Timeline and comments are bounded by quirky.hosting; partialFailures identify unavailable sources.

id.description: Provider comment ID, or null when omitted upstream.

viewerCanUpdate.description: Whether GitHub confirms this issue description can be edited; null means capability is unknown. Runtime bounds: nullable/variant values are validated by the handler.

method.description: Edit issue title, Markdown body, status, duplicate target, labels or assignees; Project items use ambient public Project mutation routing.

body.description: Local issues allow up to 1 MiB; GitHub Project issue mutations are bounded to 65,536 bytes by the public hosting API. Runtime bounds: maxLength=1048576.

labels.description: Replace current issue labels; [] clears them. Runtime bounds: maxItems=100.

assignees.description: Replace current issue assignees; [] clears them. Runtime bounds: maxItems=100.

method.description: Add one Markdown comment to the open issue through the public hosting API.

repoId.description: Runtime bounds: nullable/variant values are validated by the handler.

method.description: Create exactly one GitHub issue from the session draft or provided fields, then navigate to the provider-created issue; preserves its body as a draft if GitHub cannot save it.
Discover accessible Projects with an in-memory bounded browse cache and explicit partial failures.

Set/clear a typed project field, edit issue or pull-request fields, or change issue type through public hosting methods.
Read durable project preferences or atomically patch bounded project pins, recents, views, queries, columns, widths, and roadmap zoom.

lastViewByProject.description: Runtime bounds: maxProperties=100. Map value types and bounds are enforced by the handler.

queryByView.description: Runtime bounds: maxProperties=100. Map value types and bounds are enforced by the handler.

hiddenColumns.description: Runtime bounds: maxProperties=100. Map value types and bounds are enforced by the handler.

columnWidths.description: Runtime bounds: maxProperties=100. Map value types and bounds are enforced by the handler.
